store-mock.name: Store mock (lumebook.com/IL/he rebuilt as a conversion landing page in the LumeBook design system)

publish.note: A design proposal for the store, not a live page. The local page has the project nav; web/index.html is the review copy for the store team on Vercel (since 09 Nov 2026, Yarin: "Yes, deploy it"): no project nav, no local-links map, no design comments, robots noindex nofollow, canonical lumebook.com/IL/he. Covers, customer photos and the logo load from lumebook.com.

rules: content.json is the source; never edit index.html by hand. The build fails on an em or en dash, the brand spelt with a yod, a category missing from shared/design/categories.json set store-shelves, or a book id without an entry.

Prices, delivery, books and answers come from the live store (read 09 / 11 / 2026). When the store changes them, read the store again and update content.json; never invent a policy the store does not state (CRO audit A4 and A5 in research/cro-crm/audit.md).
Parent-facing Hebrew follows the lumebook-hebrew-voice hard rules; the whole store area is translate="no" (audience copy stays Hebrew in both languages).

The one page with a dark mode and a dark/light switch (Yarin, 09 Nov 2026): page tokens in the store's night purple and gold on html.st-night, light = the design system's white tokens, no project nav. Keep both modes working when changing the CSS (colours go through the --st-* slots or design tokens, never a hard-coded dark or light value). Never copy the switch or the dark tokens to another page.
The working demo never sends anything: the photo is shrunk in the browser, the order is pretend, books stay in this browser's localStorage, and it never asks for payment details.
store-mock.notes: Made 09 Nov 2026. Yarin's requests in order: a mock of lumebook.com/IL/he in the dashboard's design system; restructure it as the best landing page for starting a book and selling; deploy it; no side bar; the violet promo capsule looked bad; dark and magical in the store's purple; heavily animate; as many icons and images as possible; deals instead of delivery with the usual price 149; a fully working demo where everything does something and he can create a fake book; a dark and light switch. Order: promo, sticky bar (switch, my books, start), hero with a name and boy or girl start card, trust numbers, covers marquee, filterable shelf (best sellers first, shared/facts.json top_books), four steps, customer books and a review, why with the banner, price and deals, questions, final call, other products, footer. README has the details.

home-redesign.name: Home redesign demo: lumebook.com's three experiences (kids books, gift books for adults, photo albums) as one site, in two visual directions with light and dark

publish.note: A demo (Yarin, 17 Nov 2026: "its just a demo"), not deployed or published. compare.html shows the four combinations side by side (dev only). Every start button leads to the live store flow.

rules: src/build.py holds all copy and facts; never edit the built HTML. The build fails on an em or en dash, the yod spelling, AI wording, a hyphen or maqaf between Hebrew words, a semicolon in Hebrew text or an empty link.

Prices, formats, delivery and flows were read from lumebook.com on 17 / 11 / 2026 (/IL/he and its FAQPage data, /IL/he/gift-books, /IL/he/albums, /IL/he/books/15). Re-read the store before changing them; never state a policy the store does not.

Customer content: only the photos the store already shows on its home page (with its captions) and Google reviews word for word from media/projects/2026-11-15-social-proof/data.json. Album pictures are the store's illustrative ones and are labelled as such.
No project nav and no language switch: this is an audience page (translate=no), like the store mock.

The creation studio (assets/studio.js) and the pretend account never send anything: accounts, photos and books stay in this browser's localStorage, passwords only as a salted SHA-256 hash, photos shrunk in the page, and an order is a confirmation screen with no payment step. Every screen says it is a demo and links to the real store flow.
Squircle corners everywhere (Yarin, 17 Nov 2026): corner-shape: squircle on every element under @supports, with larger radius tokens; browsers without it keep plain rounded corners.

Identity v1 (Yarin's brand kit of 17 Nov 2026, shared/brand/identity-v1): 3D hat + Heebo 900 wordmark in the text colour, kit colours in the token blocks (A = the identity's own light and dark themes, B = identity yellow with ink text), kit icons, Heebo 700/400, radii 16/24/32. Never use the kit's concept product scenes as product pictures.

Three versions since 17 Nov 2026 (Yarin): purple tint and yellow tint (monochrome greys with a slight cast, ink buttons, dusty accent), plus the merged purple + yellow; html[data-dir], dev switch only. Each version sets only colour slots. The Apple layer at the end of site.css (Liquid Glass on controls only, skeuomorphic books, paper, receipt and prints, spring motion off under Reduce Motion) is shared.
home-redesign.notes: Made 17 Nov 2026 from Yarin's brief: one homepage over the three store categories, Lullaby.ink as the quality reference, two directions (A purple #5B2BD6 + monochrome, B gold #E6B762 + warm neutrals), each light and dark, system appearance first with a remembered toggle, a dev-only direction switch. README has the asset list, the facts and the open questions.

deploy.note: Review copy for phones (Yarin, 17 Nov 2026). Refresh: build home-redesign, python3 sites/lumebook-home-redesign/src/web.py, deploy home-redesign. robots noindex.

mebook-customer-research.notes: 14 Nov 2026 (Yarin pasted a customer-research brief: MeBook buyers' motivations, objections, occasions and language, turned into content hypotheses for LumeBook; then "super organized html", "in hebrew"). Sources: MeBook's Google listing (67 reviews, read in Hebrew), 41 verified reviews on mebook.ai book pages, 252 Instagram and TikTok comments from the competitor teardown, one public Facebook group question. social-proof.name: Social proof (הוכחה חברתית: every good review and comment on LumeBook as a screenshot, tagged by theme, and every real photo or video of a child with their book)
social-proof.schedule: scheduled task lumebook-social-proof-daily, 06:30 every day: new reviews, comments and kid photos, then rebuild

publish.note: Local only: the screenshots and thumbnails sit in the media folder (not in git). The files themselves are copied to the two Drive folders in shared/facts.json drive_marketing.social_proof.

rules: data.json is the source: reviews[] (screenshot, platform, themes, Drive copy id) and kids[] (Drive original and copy ids, thumbnail). Theme hues from shared/design/categories.json set proof-themes.
Copies only: the Drive folders hold copies; never move the originals (Yarin, 15 Nov 2026: "dont move media from one place to another, duplicate it").
Good = 4 or 5 stars, or a comment that praises; bare keyword comments (לומי) and complaints are left out. Yarin's own review is left out.

removed.json lists the cards Yarin removed on the page (15 Nov 2026: "delete irrelevant cards so you wont use them in the future"; keys review:<id> and kid:<file name>). When picking media from this page, its folders or data.json, skip every listed key. Nothing is deleted from disk; tools/social_proof.py, GET and PUT /api/social-proof/removed.
